EDITOR_REVIEW_PREVIEW.access: trusted authenticated editors and QA staff only
EDITOR_REVIEW_PREVIEW.must_display_watermark: 內部審閱候選｜非正式顧客報告
EDITOR_REVIEW_PREVIEW.logging: source snapshot + claim ids + generated artifact id

release_guard_conditions: All code source records used by a specific report are APPROVED with real reviewer and approved_at.
Every customer-facing cross-code claim is APPROVED and anchored to approved source fields from that same snapshot.
User-facing chapters 02, 07, 14 use consistent claims; Chapter 07 may only use S1/S3/S2/S0.
An approved content snapshot and approved integration rule set are active; no draft reference can be substituted.
Privacy, consent, age eligibility, safety notes, QA, and final product owner release authorization are passed.
No formulas, source-fields, internal anchors, mapping thresholds, source hashes, or code derivation are served to customer endpoints.

when_blocked.display_message_zh_tw: 編碼已產生，完整敘事尚未核准。

approved_snapshot_naming.rule: Approved version identifiers may only be minted after signed editorial review. Partial approved snapshots must specify exact module coverage.
